class.name: PhysicsIntersectRayResult2D
class.brief_description: Stores the result of a ray intersection query.
class.description: This object contains the intersection information produced by [method PhysicsDirectSpaceState2D.intersect_ray_into]. After calling [method PhysicsDirectSpaceState2D.intersect_ray_into], the fields of this object will be populated with the hit information if the ray intersects a shape. If no intersection occurred, the values remain unchanged from the previous state.

members.member: The shape index of the colliding shape.
The object's surface normal at the intersection point, or [code]Vector2(0, 0)[/code] if the ray starts inside the shape and [member PhysicsRayQueryParameters2D.hit_from_inside] is [code]true[/code].
